answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. The ember lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the sable is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
